units.title: Coordination
units.triggerDescription: Durable participant messaging, shared work threads, and concrete assignment ownership.

units.title: Agent Spawn Guard
units.triggerDescription: Enforces the configured delegation surface and terminal worker authority before spawn-like tool calls.

units.title: Log Compression Hook
units.triggerDescription: Compresses large tool output into a bounded provider context representation.

units.title: North On Spawn
units.triggerDescription: Registers provider identity and coordination context when an agent starts.

units.title: North On Tool Use
units.triggerDescription: Surfaces bounded coordination messages after tool calls.

units.title: North On Stop
units.triggerDescription: Keeps delegated coordination listeners armed across stop events.

units.title: North On Terminal
units.triggerDescription: Publishes bounded provider-native coordination telemetry when a delegated agent stops.

units.title: North Mark Delegated
units.triggerDescription: Marks sessions that delegated work so completion coordination remains armed.
